## About
Bugs Incorporated is a family owned and operated pest control company run by Anita and Gary Mancini, right here on Avenue A in Katy. The business has been built on referrals from customers, and we serve Katy and the Houston/Metro areas.
We use Integrated Pest Management, which means we start with inspection and identification, then treat inside and outside your home in the most environmentally responsible way we can. The goal is to fix the problem you have now and help keep it from coming back.
We are proud supporters of the Katy Police and Fire Departments and the Katy Independent School District. Customers on Google rate us 4.4 from 78 reviews.

## Services
- General pest control: Routine treatment for the common pests that find their way into Katy homes.
- Termite control: Treatment when termites become a problem at your home.
- Fire ant control: Treatment for fire ants around your home and yard.
- Quarterly spraying plan: Regular scheduled service. One longtime customer on the plan said they can request the same technician each time.

## FAQ
Q: Is there a discount for military, civil servants or teachers?
A: Yes. All military personnel, civil servants and teachers get an instant discount on any of our services.

Q: Can I get a free quote?
A: Yes. Give us a call, email bugsincorporated@aol.com, or send a request through the contact form.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Katy and the Houston/Metro areas.
